preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 10**3 for N, K, S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of blocks N is between 2 and 1,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= N for N, K, S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of jumps K is between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N for N, K, S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the binary string S is equal to N.

preconditions.expression: all(S[i] in '01' for N, K, S in test_cases for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the binary string S consists only of '0' and '1'.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, K, S in test_cases) <= 5 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] == -1 or (1 <= result[i] <= N and result[i] - 1 == K) for i, (N, K, S) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the result is either -1 if Chef cannot make exactly K jumps, or the farthest block number Chef can reach with exactly K jumps.
